title: Text requests take a faster default route
summary:
The week made common requests less fussy while giving two community-made creative tools a place to be found.

Text requests without a model now default to `openai-fast`; explicitly selected models are unchanged. Configurable routing was added for specified authenticated users, alongside `openai-roblox` and updates to several model tier labels.

Token validation now fetches user details in one query instead of three. A test response dropped from roughly 12 seconds to 2.1 seconds, and image generation reuses one authentication result throughout a request.

BGE-based semantic caching lets similar image prompts match cached results without being identical. Normalization also strips punctuation and collapses repeated whitespace, so `test.`, `test...`, and `test` match the same way.

CraftUI became the first entry in the Vibe Coding projects list, turning prompts and images into editable UI components. Unfoldtech joined Creative Projects with a path from Pexels inspiration to prompts and generated images, including IPTC metadata in downloads.
